q.en: Find the rank of the following matrices by minor method: (i) [[2, −4; −1, 2]]

steps.en: The rank is the largest order of a nonzero minor. Start by locating one nonzero minor; then rule out higher orders.
Rows 1 and columns 1 give a nonzero minor.
Every minor of order 2 is zero. Checking all row/column choices gives the following determinants, so no higher-rank independent rows or columns exist.
The lower and upper bounds agree.
